main.remarks: This interface defines the operational contracts of the ToolHost.

method.name: Run
method.summary: Run the ToolHost synchronously until it is stopped.
method.param: An access key authorized to start and stop a locked ToolHost.
The timeout for host startup and shutdown; null means no timeout.
method.returns: True if the ToolHost starts and stops successfully; otherwise, false.

method.name: RunAsync
method.summary: Run the ToolHost asynchronously until cancellation or host shutdown.
method.param: An access key authorized to start and stop a locked ToolHost.
The timeout for host startup and shutdown; null means no timeout.
A cancellation token that requests host shutdown.
method.returns: True if the ToolHost starts and stops successfully; otherwise, false.
